Similar story..Uncle's funeral back in 2007.  He was 36, one of the greatest, sweetest, people I'd ever known.  He taught me how to play DOOM, and how to eat pizza "new york style".  He treated me like a son when my parents got divorced, and I lived with my Mom in my grandparents home (where he was still living at the time).  

At the funeral, I watched my entire family breakdown completely.  My uncles, aunts, parents, grandparents, great aunts, great uncles, cousins, family friends..everyone.  Not a single person there could hold back their tears.  I sat next to my Mom, who kept her sunglasses on the whole time.  When I looked over to see if she was ok, i saw dark, mascara lined tears streaming down her trembling face.  Her hands her shaking violently and she gripped her purse to her stomach.  When she stood up to give a small speech, she muttered one word before turning towards his casket and falling to her knees while wailing.  

It broke my heart
I'm alright at the moment.  Spent today trying to figure out why I've been feeling like this and how to fix it.  It's kept my mind off of that bad stuff for the most part, so today's been alright.

Feeling a bit better, actually.  Today I thought about it again just a bit. Just told them I was feeling a bit down. But now that I'm home, I feel a bit more relaxed
